name: Partial Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with heels hanging off.
Rise onto your toes through the top half of the range only.
Squeeze the calves hard at the peak.
Lower to mid-range and repeat. Overloads the contracted position.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Partial Calf Raise is a beginner core exercise targeting the calves, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
